_comment: Новые строки порта, которых не было в оригинале. Каждая обязана иметь перевод в ru_ru.extra.json.
thaumcraft.configuration.largeTagText.to: Setting this to true will make the amount text in aspect tags twice as large. Useful for certain resolutions and custom fonts.
This setting will disable certain thaumcraft shaders for those who experience FPS drops.
thaumcraft.configuration.nostress.toolti: Set to true to disable anxiety triggers like the heartbeat sound.
thaumcraft.configuration.crooked.tooltip: Hate crooked labels, kittens, puppies and all things awesome? If yes, set this to false.
thaumcraft.configuration.dialBottom.tool: Set to true to have the wand dial display in the bottom left instead of the top left.
thaumcraft.configuration.showTags.toolti: Item aspects are hidden by default and pressing shift reveals them. Changing this setting to 'true' will reverse this behaviour and always display aspects unless shift is pressed.
thaumcraft.configuration.blueBiome.toolt: Set this to true to get the old blue magical forest back.
thaumcraft.configuration.showGolemEmotes: Will golems display emote particles if they recieve orders or encounter problems
thaumcraft.configuration.wussMode.toolti: Setting this to true disables Warp, Taint spread and similar mechanics. You wuss.
thaumcraft.configuration.allowCheatSheet: Enables a version of the Thauminomicon in creative mode that grants you all the research when you first use it.
How many milliseconds passes between runic shielding recharge ticks. Lower values equals faster recharge. Minimum of 500.
thaumcraft.configuration.shieldWait.tool: How many milliseconds passes after a shield has been reduced to zero before it can start recharging again. Minimum of 0.
thaumcraft.configuration.shieldCost.tool: How much vis it costs to reacharge a single unit of shielding. Minimum of 0.
thaumcraft.configuration.overworldDim.to: The dimension considered to be your 'overworld'. Certain TC structures will only spawn in this dim.
thaumcraft.configuration.oreDensity.tool: The % of normal ore amounts that will be spawned. For example 50 will spawn half the ores while 200 will spawn double. Default 100
thaumcraft.configuration.biomeMagicalFor: Higher values increases number of magical forest biomes. If you are using biome addon mods you probably want to increase this weight quite a bit
thaumcraft.configuration.taintSpreadRate: The % chance of taint fibres spreading on a block tick. Setting this to 0 will effectively stop taint fibre spread.
thaumcraft.configuration.taintSpreadArea: The range at which taint can spread from a taint seed. This value is only a base and will be modified by flux levels.
thaumcraft.configuration.regenKey.toolti: This key is used to keep track of which chunk have been generated/regenerated. Changing it will cause the regeneration code to run again, so only change it if you want it to happen. Useful to regen only one world feature at a time.
thaumcraft.configuration.allowChampionMo: Setting this to false will disable spawning champion mobs. Even when false they will still have a greatly reduced chance of spawning in certain dangerous places.
thaumcraft.configuration.title: Thaumcraft Configuration

thaumcraft.command.help.2: §3Use this to give research to a player.
thaumcraft.command.help.4: §3Use this to give set a players warp level.
thaumcraft.command.help.6: not specifying perm or temp will just add normal warp
thaumcraft.command.help.7: §3Use this to reload json research data
thaumcraft.command.research.gave: §5%s gave you %s research and its requisites.
